title: Path Traversal Detection: URL Path, Filename, and Username Vectors
goal: Gruyere has three path traversal attack vectors that AegisPT currently cannot detect: (1) URL path traversal — /[instance-id]/../secret.txt reads files outside the instance directory; (2) Filename path traversal — uploading a file named '../secret.txt' overwrites files outside the upload directory; (3) Username path traversal — creating an account with username '..' or 'brie/../..' causes uploaded files to escape the user directory. The nuclei runner has limited path traversal templates but they target known CVEs. Extend the nuclei runner or add a dedicated path traversal probe that: (a) tests /../ sequences in URL paths to read known sensitive filenames (secret.txt, config.txt, .env, settings.py, gruyere.py); (b) tests filename parameters in file upload forms with ../ prefixes; (c) checks HTTP responses for leaked file content patterns (Python source code, passwords, API keys). This runner requires the crawler (backlog-343) to have discovered file upload endpoints first.
generation_reason: Gruyere's path traversal via /../secret.txt, filename ../secret.txt, and username-based traversal are not detected by current runners. Nuclei has CVE-specific templates but no generic path traversal probe for custom web apps.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.no_write_by_default: Filename traversal tests use non-destructive filenames (aegispt-traversal-probe.txt, not overwriting real files). Only test write paths if run_safety settings explicitly allow intrusive tests.
constraints.scope_enforcement: All probed URLs must be within approved scope.
constraints.detection_only: Report the vulnerability — do NOT actually overwrite server files. The finding should include the URL and evidence that the traversal is possible (e.g., response contains Python source code or 'secret' content).
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep implementation bounded to this task package. Defer broader scanner, exploit-chain, UI, or runtime work to separately queued packages.

implementation_notes.detection_logic: For each base_target + traversal_payload: GET request, check if response.status_code == 200 AND response.text contains content patterns (import, def , password=, secret=, API_KEY). NOT just a 200 status — verify content looks like file data.
implementation_notes.profile_name: Register probe under nuclei runner configuration or as 'active-path-traversal' profile. Add to Phase 2 of FULL-EXTERNAL-WEB.
